newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LAST GASP PENALTY GIVES AUXERRE 1-1 DRAW AT PSG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LAST GASP PENALTY GIVES AUXERRE 1-1 DRAW AT PSG.

text.p: A last minute penalty by Antoine Sibierski earned champions Auxerre a 1-1 draw with leaders Paris St Germain in the highlight match of the French soccer first division on Sunday.
The Parisians, who keep a six-point lead over Monaco, dominated for most of the first half and opened the scoring through former Nantes defender Benoit Cauet in the 35th minute.
But Auxerre, despite losing international playmaker Sabri Lamouchi, reacted in the second half and amply deserved their late equaliser in the 90th minute.
Auxerre are now third on 22 points, one behind Monaco, who crushed neighbouring Nice 4-1 on Saturday.
